verdict.rationale: Smooth is a hosted service, so data portability applies. The REST API can list all of a user's tasks (smooth-docs-37) and returns structured, schema-defined outputs (smooth-docs-5, smooth-docs-20), which gives programmatic access to task records. Enterprise Zero Data Retention lets you delete task data (smooth-docs-10), which helps with leaving cleanly but is deletion, not export. missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, export of browser profiles/cookies/session data, a stated open export format, an OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and any independent confirmation that a user can extract everything and leave.
